headline: STL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 4.71 at OAK 3.79, with a projected total of 8.51. The projected total fell -1.73, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Michael McGreevy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Shea Langeliers, Jacob Wilson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Victor Scott II, Pedro Pagés because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
